sources.cloudtainer_test: Branch/fold trajectory toy: exact simulator where subtasks emit long evidence logs; score state preservation after folding vs full-history and naïve summary.
sources.title: Context-Folding: Scaling Long-Horizon LLM Agent via Context-Folding

sources.claim: Continual memory tasks require rewriting outdated instructions, not merely retaining old cues; diagnostic tasks include sequences where new cues invalidate old ones.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Overwrite trap: streaming key updates where old facts become harmful; compare cache eviction, stale-averse retention, and explicit rewrite memory.
sources.title: Memory Retention Is Not Enough to Master Memory Tasks: Memory Rewriting Diagnostics
EASE-TTT: Evidence-Aligned Selective Test-Time Training for Long-Context Question Answering
sources.claim: Retrieved evidence chunks can supervise query-side attention adaptation instead of replacing the full context; small decoder models improve on LongBench QA in the paper setting.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Toy query-vector update: convert retrieval hits into a soft target and measure evidence mass/answer accuracy against retrieval-only and random adaptation.

sources.title: Still: Amortized KV Cache Compaction in a Single Forward Pass
sources.claim: A small Perceiver-style module with latent queries can compact each layer KV cache in one forward pass without query-specific optimization at inference.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Single-pass latent-slot compactor toy: compare latent slots, centroids, top-k, and hybrid slots on clustered topics and isolated needles.

sources.title: Semantic Cache Distillation: Efficient State Transfer via Reuse and Selective Patching
sources.claim: KV/cache state reuse breaks when producer and consumer weights differ; selective patching can adapt state across shared-architecture but weight-mismatched models.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Cross-model patch toy: rotate/distort a latent state, reuse it in a consumer, and learn minimal patch vectors only for high-error semantic regions.

sources.title: Planning-aligned Token Compression for Long-Context Autonomous Driving
sources.claim: Compression quality should be judged by downstream planning relevance, not only reconstruction or retrieval scores.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Planning-token toy: retain scene tokens under equal budget and score whether the retained set preserves action choice, not text similarity.

sources.title: A Pre-Training Analogue of Grokking in Language Models: Tracing Delayed Grammatical Generalization
sources.claim: Delayed generalization can be studied during LM pretraining by splitting examples by exposure of critical phrases rather than classic train/test labels.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Tiny grammar exposure split: train a small LM on synthetic minimal pairs and track delayed generalization after critical phrase exposure.

sources.title: From Rigid to Dynamic: Entropy-Guided Adaptive Inference for Long-Context LLMs
sources.claim: Attention heads may be rigid or dynamic in a context-dependent way; entropy can guide per-head/segment budgets, and decode tokens can help identify latent critical cache entries.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Synthetic multi-head cache budget probe: compare uniform, offline head type, entropy-adaptive, decode-conditioned entropy, and oracle policies under rigid/dynamic/trap regimes.

sources.title: Agentic Transformers Provably Learn to Search via Reinforcement Learning
sources.claim: A two-head transformer can implement randomized DFS in a stochastic tree: one head tracks actions and another detects failure/backtracking; policy-gradient curriculum can discover it.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Stochastic tree-search environment with action-trace/failure-trace ablations, DFS/ranked DFS policies, then later tiny policy-gradient transformer.

sources.title: STaR-KV: Spatio-Temporal Adaptive Re-weighting for KV Cache Compression in GUI Vision-Language Models
sources.claim: GUI/VLM cache utility can specialize by attention subspace and drift over interaction time; fixed top-B fused saliency is too rigid.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Synthetic visual-grid/cache trajectory: spatial subspace role migration, temporal redundancy discount, entropy-temperature scoring, and late UI-token importance traps.

sources.title: Exact Linear Attention
sources.claim: Kernel choices might provide exact linear attention while constraining gradients and token dilution; claims include interpretable memory-lobe style modules.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Tiny kernel lab: compare softmax attention, feature-map linear attention, exact-kernel variants, and dilution/stability metrics on associative recall.

sources.title: FlashCP: Load-Balanced Communication-Efficient Context Parallelism for LLM Training
sources.claim: Long-context training sharding can waste communication through redundant KV movement; document-aware sharding is a systems-side cousin of cache/object structure.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Not a direct CPU toy; keep as a systems analogy for whole-document vs per-document segmentation in synthetic cache reuse experiments.

sources.title: KV Cache Offloading for Context-Intensive Tasks
sources.claim: Context-intensive extraction benchmarks expose failures in KV offloading/compression that are hidden by tasks requiring only sparse lookup.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Build a tiny Text2JSON-like extraction stressor where many facts must survive compression, not just a single needle.

sources.title: Can LLMs Beat Classical Hyperparameter Optimization Algorithms? A Study on autoresearch
sources.claim: Classical HPO methods beat pure LLM agents in fixed search spaces; code-editing narrows but does not close the gap; Centaur shares CMA-ES state with an LLM and performs best in their experiments.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Toy HPO/autoresearch benchmark with OOM cliffs: random/TPE/CMA-ish/stateless-domain-prior vs Centaur-style state+domain hybrid.

sources.title: EEVEE: Towards Test-time Prompt Learning in the Real World for Self-Improving Agents
sources.claim: Multi-dataset test-time prompt learning uses a router that partitions heterogeneous task streams and co-evolves router and prompt configurations.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Tiny router-prompt coevolution toy: nonstationary task stream where one prompt per cluster must adapt without cross-cluster interference.

sources.title: Predicting Future Behaviors in Reasoning Models Enables Better Steering
sources.claim: Future-behavior probes can predict likely downstream reasoning behavior from intermediate steps; steering via candidate sentence selection can preserve quality better than direct activation steering.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Tiny future-failure probe: predict whether a partial search/reasoning trace will backtrack, loop, hallucinate, or succeed; use probe to choose next trace expansion.

sources.title: TRACE: A Unified Rollout Budget Allocation Framework for Efficient Agentic Reinforcement Learning
sources.claim: TRACE allocates rollout budget to prompt roots and intermediate prefixes likely to yield mixed terminal rewards, improving reward contrast under fixed rollout budgets.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Synthetic tree rollout allocation: uniform vs root-level vs prefix-contrast vs oracle allocation on sparse terminal rewards.

sources.title: A Unifying Lens on Supervised Fine-Tuning Through Target Distribution Design
sources.claim: SFT can be reframed as token-level target distribution design; Target-SFT chooses how much probability to put on observed tokens versus alternatives.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Toy ambiguous-demonstration SFT: one-hot targets vs softened target distributions on noisy algorithmic traces.

sources.title: When to Align, When to Predict: A Phase Diagram for Multimodal Learning
sources.claim: A linear phase diagram can predict when cross-modal alignment, cross-modal prediction, both, or neither should work under signal/noise/nuisance regimes.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Methodology import: build phase diagrams for cache/memory probes before training; diagnose when a compression role should be beneficial or harmful.

sources.title: The Residual Stream Is All You Need: On the Redundancy of the KV Cache in Transformer Inference
sources.claim: KV tensors are deterministic from residual states; KV-Direct stores residual checkpoints and recomputes K/V to reduce memory while preserving outputs in their tests.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native residual-vs-KV object cost probe: exact projection sanity plus byte/time frontier for full KV, residual checkpoints, and lossy sliding window.

sources.title: Move the Query, Not the Cache: Characterizing Cross-Instance Latent and Sparse Attention Redistribution Across GPU Fabrics
sources.claim: For sparse/latent attention over remote chunks, moving a small query row can be cheaper than moving selected KV cache blocks; the route/fetch predicate depends on fabric and payload sizes.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native cross-instance cost model: move query vs move cache vs local recompute across block counts, batch sizes, fabrics, and latent/KV payload sizes.

sources.title: AURA: Action-Gated Memory for Robot Policies at Constant VRAM
sources.claim: In endless batch-1 embodied episodes, unbounded KV cache is the wrong memory; action surprise can gate writes to a constant-size state.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Action-surprise write gate toy: only write memory when predicted action would change, compare to periodic/random/every-step writes under sparse recall/control traces.

sources.title: Multi-Segment Attention: Enabling Efficient KV-Cache Management for Faster Large Language Model Serving
sources.claim: AsymCache treats lossless cache residency as a latency optimization problem, with non-contiguous multi-segment attention and position/recompute-aware eviction.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Block-residency scheduler toy: optimize hit rate plus recompute/attention-kernel cost instead of hit rate alone.

sources.title: Entropy Gate: Entropy Quenching for Near-Lossless Token Compression in LLM Pipelines
sources.claim: Compressing redundant prompt/output tokens before activation/cache machinery can compose with cache compression; tokens get energy/survival scores.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Token-quench adversarial stream: remove low-energy repeated tokens, but red-team rare low-frequency anchors and later dependencies.

sources.title: Exact Linear Attention
sources.claim: Proposes exact kernel decompositions for linear-complexity attention plus constraints aimed at avoiding dilution/explosion.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Kernel support toy: compare exact decomposable kernels on associative recall, dilution, and adversarial near-neighbor retrieval.

sources.title: Beyond Tokens: A Unified Framework for Latent Communication in LLM-based Multi-Agent Systems
sources.claim: Latent communication can move embeddings, hidden states, or KV caches; information richness, transport cost, and architecture-dependence form an ordering.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Latent object taxonomy audit: classify CloudtainerML probes by WHAT/WHICH/HOW so cache/object experiments do not blur together.

sources.title: Can LLMs Beat Classical Hyperparameter Optimization Algorithms? A Study on autoresearch
sources.claim: Classical HPO beats pure LLM agents in fixed spaces, but Centaur improves by sharing CMA-ES state with an LLM; reliability/OOM avoidance matters strongly.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Centaur-style state-sharing optimizer for choosing CloudtainerML sweep configs: classical state plus domain-prior overrides.

sources.title: Vortex: Efficient and Programmable Sparse Attention Serving for AI Agents
sources.claim: Sparse attention ideas need programmable serving substrates; Vortex provides a Python-embedded sparse attention frontend plus backend to iterate algorithms quickly.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Make a tiny sparse-attention policy DSL/catalog so C++ probes can share routing policies instead of ad hoc loops.

sources.title: Stochastic Sparse Attention for Memory-Bound Inference
sources.claim: SANTA samples post-softmax value rows to form an unbiased value aggregation estimator, reducing value-cache reads in memory-bound decoding.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ estimator wind tunnel: compare post-softmax Monte Carlo, stratified sampling, top-k, and value-aware sampling under rare high-value tails.

sources.title: TokenMizer: Graph-Structured Session Memory for Long-Horizon LLM Context Management
sources.claim: Long-horizon session history can be modeled as a typed knowledge graph and serialized into compact resume blocks, preserving rationale/structure better than flat text baselines.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Graph memory toy for agent traces: preserve decisions, files, task transitions, and failure fixes under fixed token budget.

sources.title: Forget, Then Recall: Learnable Compression and Selective Unfolding via Gist Sparse Attention
sources.claim: Interleaved gist tokens can summarize chunks and route sparse attention to raw chunks that need selective unfolding; recursive gist-of-gist gives multi-resolution context access.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Coarse-to-fine router toy: gist summaries choose raw chunks; adversarial isolated needles test whether unfolding recovers detail.

sources.title: Observation, Not Prediction: Conversation-Level Disaggregated Scheduling for Agentic Serving
sources.claim: Scheduling at conversation level can replace turn-level predictions with observable first-turn prefill and decoder KV occupancy, reducing time-to-first-effective-token and energy in their system.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Conversation-level cost toy: decide prefill/decode placement from observable prefix/occupancy rather than predicted tail length.

sources.title: HybridKV: Hybrid KV Cache Compression for Efficient Multimodal Large Language Model Inference
sources.claim: Different attention heads may need distinct compression strategies; HybridKV classifies static/dynamic heads and combines text-prior pruning with chunk retrieval.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Head-type classifier toy: static text-prior heads versus dynamic chunk-retrieval heads under visual/text-token imbalance.

sources.title: Training-Free Native Sparse Attention for KV Cache Compression
sources.claim: Hierarchical block-wise selection can adapt native sparse-attention insights to training-free KV compression.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Block hierarchy probe: compare token top-k, flat block top-k, and hierarchical block selection on region-wipeout traps.

sources.title: Recalling Too Well: Sycophancy Evaluation and Mitigation in Memory-Augmented Models
sources.claim: Persistent memory can amplify sycophancy when extraction stores user misconceptions while dropping corrective context; the authors report much higher sycophancy rates than in-context baselines and propose lightweight mitigations.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Symbolic memory red-team: compare belief snippets, recency memory, provenance-balanced memory, skeptical high-stakes memory, no-memory, and oracle memory.
sources.charter_role: side-wing: state/trust/safety, not core project focus

sources.title: Pushing the Limits of LLM Tool Calling via Experiential Knowledge Integration and Activation
sources.claim: KATE finds instance-level experiential knowledge gives strong tool-use gains, width-expanded reasoning activates it better than deeper reasoning, and knowledge-aware RL improves internalization.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Agent toy: memory bank of concrete tool episodes versus abstract intents; compare depth expansion, width sampling, and aggregation under tool-call traps.

sources.title: Unifying Local Communications and Local Updates for LLM Pretraining
sources.claim: GASLoC generalizes communication acceleration to outer optimizers with gossip-based training, local optimizer steps, and sparse randomized peer communication under heterogeneous bandwidth.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Tiny distributed optimizer simulator: stale local updates plus sparse gossip over toy loss surfaces; test convergence versus all-reduce and DiLoCo-like averaging.

sources.title: Periodic KV Cache Consolidation for Generalised Reasoning
sources.claim: Bottlenecked Transformer uses a cache processor to periodically rewrite KV entries at reasoning-step boundaries, preserving/boosting math reasoning under bottlenecked cache.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Step-boundary rewrite toy: compare continuous eviction, newline/step-boundary consolidation, and learned merge on multi-hop traces.

sources.title: VeriCache: Turning Lossy KV Cache into Lossless LLM Inference
sources.claim: Lossy KV compression can diverge over long decoding, especially in code and tool calling; verification/recovery can convert lossy cache behavior into lossless-equivalent generation in risky cases.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Verifier guard wind tunnel: simulate long decode drift, critical tool-call sites, and selective recompute triggered by margin/drift/risk signals.

sources.title: Tensor Memory: Fixed-Size Recurrent State for Long-Horizon Transformers
sources.claim: Augments transformer blocks with a fixed-size recurrent 3D memory tensor using differentiable soft writes, local interaction, gated recurrent dynamics, and continuous reads.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Tiny spatial-memory probe: hidden moving objects/facts are written to a fixed grid; compare flat KV retention, tensor memory, and recency windows.

sources.title: CSR: Infinite-Horizon Real-Time Policies with Massive Cached State Representations
sources.claim: For real-time embodied policies, prefix stability, incremental extensibility, and asynchronous state reconciliation enable long cached state with bounded latency spikes.
sources.cloudtainer_test: CSR/ASR scheduler toy: state prefix stability plus asynchronous eviction/reconciliation under latency-spike constraints.

sources.title: Gated Memory Policy
sources.claim: Learns when to recall historical context and what to recall; long history can hurt Markovian tasks via distribution shift and overfitting.
sources.cloudtainer_test: History-gate toy: mix Markovian and non-Markovian episodes; test if learned/gated recall beats always-history and no-history baselines.

sources.title: Reasoning Cache: Continual Improvement Over Long Horizons via Short-Horizon RL
sources.claim: Replaces standard autoregressive decoding with an iterative response-plus-summary cache that can improve over horizons longer than training budgets.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Iterative summarize/refine toy: response statement plus summary state over many turns; compare plain chain, compressed summary, and learned update.

sources.title: KV Cache Optimization Strategies for Scalable and Efficient LLM Inference
sources.claim: Survey organizes KV optimization into eviction, compression/reconstruction, hybrid memory, new attention mechanisms, and combinations; no single technique dominates all settings.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Use as taxonomy pressure: every CloudtainerML cache probe should declare which bucket and what adversarial regime it targets.

sources.title: How Does Reasoning Flow? Tracing Attention-Induced Information Flow for Targeted RL in LLMs
sources.claim: Token-level credit should follow answer-targeted information flow through an attention-induced DAG rather than uniform or pointwise heuristics.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ FlowTrace toy: generate reasoning DAGs with true bridge tokens and decoys; compare uniform, recency, local attention mass, max-path, answer-targeted flow, and oracle credit.

sources.title: Hasse Diagrams for Attention: A Partial Order Framework for Designing Transformer Masks
sources.claim: Attention-mask information flow can be formalized as a partial-order/Hasse diagram, enabling constructive task-mask design and training-inference consistency analysis.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ mask frontier toy: define required and forbidden reachability for task families; score mask policies on coverage, leakage, redundancy, and train-infer gap.

sources.title: REAL: A Reasoning-Enhanced Graph Framework for Long-Term Memory Management of LLMs
sources.claim: Long-term memory should preserve temporal validity, confidence, parallel fact versions, and exploration intent, with retrieval as guided subgraph search instead of flat recall.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Extend topic-graph memory probe with valid intervals, confidence, non-destructive revisions, and query-intent beam search under missing evidence.
sources.charter_role: side-wing: state/trust/safety, not core project focus

sources.title: From Confident Closing to Silent Failure: Characterizing False Success in LLM Agents
sources.claim: Agents can claim completion while environment state shows failure; lightweight detectors can outperform LLM judges for this failure mode.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Symbolic agent trajectory probe: generate true/false completion states with confident closing text; compare judge-like surface heuristics, TF-IDF-style detectors, and environment-state verifiers.

sources.title: T1-Bench: Benchmarking Multi-Scenario Agents in Real-World Domains
sources.claim: Agent benchmarks need multi-domain, multi-turn scenarios with sustained reasoning and coordination rather than isolated tasks.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Tiny multi-domain agent stressor: interleaved customer-service domains with memory, state verification, task switching, and false-success traps.

sources.title: Lightweight Latent Reasoning for Narrative Tasks
sources.claim: Continuous latent tokens can substitute for some explicit reasoning tokens, reducing reasoning length while preserving task performance in narrative tasks.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Latent/discrete router toy: train or simulate when projector-like latent steps should replace visible reasoning tokens under retrieval-heavy tasks.

sources.title: Does Reasoning Preserve Alignment? On the Trustworthiness of Large Reasoning Models
sources.claim: Reasoning post-training can improve reasoning benchmarks while regressing trustworthiness dimensions such as safety, toxicity, bias, privacy, and robustness.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Alignment-regression toy: pair a reasoning-improvement objective with safety/privacy canaries and measure tradeoff/frontier under synthetic post-training updates.

sources.title: Provenance-Grounded Gating and Adaptive Recovery in Synthetic Post-Training Data Curation
sources.claim: Source-grounded faithfulness gates and reward/hallucination gates catch different synthetic-data failures; rejected samples can sometimes be recovered by diagnosis-targeted regeneration rather than discarded.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ provenance gate/recovery simulator with reward-only, provenance-only, dual-gate, adaptive-recovery, and naive-resample arms.
sources.charter_role: side-wing: state/trust/safety, not core project focus

sources.title: Janus: A Benchmark for Goal-Conditioned Information Distortion in LLMs
sources.claim: Misleading output can arise from selectively emphasizing, omitting, softening, or vagueness-shifting true facts under a goal, even without hallucination.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ fixed-fact-pool distortion probe measuring favorable/adverse coverage and distortion under goal pressure and provenance contracts.
sources.charter_role: side-wing: state/trust/safety, not core project focus

sources.title: Continual LLM Upcycling: A Predictor-Gated Bank-Wise Sparsity Training Recipe for Dense-to-Sparse LLMs
sources.claim: A low-rank predictor can route token/layer FFN channels with a bank-wise top-k rule during continued training, producing hardware-oriented sparse activations and exposing layer-local long-context failures.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ channel-bank routing simulator comparing global top-k, bank-wise top-k, random bank-wise, oracle, and single-layer repair.

sources.title: Prefilling-dLLM: Predictive Prefilling for Long-Context Inference in Diffusion Language Models
sources.claim: Chunk-level KV caching plus top-K chunk selection and intra-chunk sparsity can speed dLLM long-context inference, and beginning-of-chunk anchors may reduce lost-in-the-middle failures.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ chunk-selection toy with sparse top-k chunks, periodic anchors, dense baseline, and oracle target chunks.

sources.title: ConvMemory v2: A Recall-Preserving Top-10 Evidence Reranker for Conversational Memory Retrieval
sources.claim: A small cross-encoder reranker can improve rank quality inside a protected top-10 memory candidate set without changing Recall@10/Hit@10 by construction.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future C++/Python cascade toy: fixed candidate set recall, rerank-only quality, anti-shortcut ablations, and slice-specific failures.

sources.title: LC-QAT: Data-Efficient 2-Bit QAT for LLMs via Linear-Constrained Vector Quantization
sources.claim: A learned affine mapping over discrete vectors can make 2-bit vector-quantized weights differentiable and data-efficient for QAT.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Tiny matrix/codebook toy for differentiable linear-constrained VQ vs scalar quantization under equal bits.

sources.title: Detecting Knowledge Gaps from Conversational AI Interactions Using Curriculum Prerequisite Graphs
sources.claim: Conversational question streams mapped onto prerequisite graphs can reveal topic-level knowledge gaps, not just raw frequency.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future graph-memory audit: distinguish high-volume topics from prerequisite-blocking concepts in synthetic interaction logs.

sources.title: Trustworthy Memory Search for Personal AI Agents
sources.claim: Persistent memory search can amplify sycophancy and other failures; memory retrieval requires trust, provenance, and objective/context separation.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Extend memory-provenance and sycophancy probes with search-stage trust filters and memory-object provenance.

sources.title: From Untrusted Input to Trusted Memory: A Systematic Study of Memory Poisoning Attacks in LLM Agents
sources.claim: Persistent memory is an attack surface: a single adversarial memory write can have long-term influence, and prompt-injection defenses do not fully cover memory poisoning.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native memory-poisoning gate: single-write poison vs similarity search, write-time filter, read-time gate, provenance gate, and dual gate.
sources.charter_role: side-wing: state/trust/safety, not core project focus

sources.title: Beyond Semantic Organization: Memory as Execution State Management for Long-Horizon Agents
sources.claim: Long-horizon agent memory should preserve active execution state as a path/tree, not merely retrieve semantically similar entries; branch revision isolates flawed traces.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ Mage-style state-tree probe: full context vs semantic retrieval vs active path/tree/revise policies.
sources.charter_role: side-wing: state/trust/safety, not core project focus

sources.title: Agent Memory: Characterization and System Implications of Stateful Long-Horizon Workloads
sources.claim: Agent memory has distinct construction, retrieval, and generation costs; LLM-mediated construction can dominate lifecycle energy/cost.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native lifecycle cost phase diagram: cheap flat indexing vs structured/agentic construction across query volume, freshness, and mutation.

sources.title: Memory is Reconstructed, Not Retrieved: Graph Memory for LLM Agents
sources.claim: Associative memory graphs can be actively reconstructed through iterative explore/prune rather than static retrieve-then-reason.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future C++ active graph reconstruction: cue-tag-content graph, static retrieval, bounded expansion, and evidence-adaptive pruning.

sources.title: A Curvature-Conditioned Query for Linear Attention
sources.claim: Linear attention readout can be improved by query-side curvature conditioning because naive readout dilutes useful targets with bulk stored vectors.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ associative-memory readout probe: additive memory vs curvature-conditioned query under target dilution.

sources.title: Q-Delta: Beyond Key–Value Associative State Evolution
sources.claim: Queries can participate in state evolution, not only readout, yielding a richer memory update mechanism for linear-attention systems.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Query-conditioned write/read state toy: compare key-only updates, delta updates, and query-participating updates on delayed recall and corrections.

sources.title: Trajectory Geometry of Transformer Representations
sources.claim: Probe-free geometric metrics can characterize representation dynamics across layers, suggesting a lightweight monitor for tiny trained models.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Add trajectory metrics to tiny trained probes: curvature, drift, anisotropy, layer path length, and regime boundary detection.

sources.title: Causal Evidence of Stack Representations in Modeling Counter Languages
sources.claim: Formal-language transformers can learn stack-like representations with causal role, not merely correlational probes.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Tiny stack-language arena: train small model, intervene on inferred stack state, compare causal edits vs accuracy-only metrics.

sources.title: Sampling, State, and the Variability of AI Agent Outputs
sources.claim: Agent outputs are shaped by sampling, state, tools, and state update loops; variability is a system property, not just model temperature.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Agent-state variability toy: same policy, different memory/update/randomness seeds, measure divergence and false-success tails.

sources.title: From Agent Traces to Trust: Evidence Tracing and Execution Provenance in LLM Agents
sources.claim: Agent memory items should be treated as evidence-bearing objects with sources, revisions, retrievals, uses, and invalidations that affect downstream behavior.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Evidence provenance DAG probe: compare semantic relevance, source/revision gates, provenance DAG scoring, and flow-style support under stale/contaminated evidence.
sources.charter_role: side-wing: state/trust/safety, not core project focus

sources.title: PersonaTree: Structured Lifecycle Memory for Person Understanding in LLM Agents
sources.claim: A three-level memory tree with support paths from evidence to claims can support concrete recall and abstract person understanding under a compact context budget.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Support-path memory toy: measure whether evidence→pattern→claim paths reduce unsupported stable claims and over-retrieval.

sources.title: Learning to Retrieve: Dual-Level Long-Term Memory for Text-to-SQL Agents
sources.claim: Memory usefulness changes across interaction stages; episode-level and turn-level memories need separate retrieval policies and denser local rewards.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Dual-horizon retrieval probe: compare static similarity, episode-only, turn-only, dual horizon, and PRM-like local signals across stage-shift regimes.

sources.title: DeltaMem: Incremental Experience Memory for LLM Agents
sources.claim: New experiences are often residual deltas from existing skills/scenes and can be organized into residual trees.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Residual experience memory toy: compare append-only, merge-summary, and delta-tree memory under near-repeat tasks and scene drift.

sources.title: OmniMem: Perturbation-aware Memory Compression for Audio-Visual LLMs
sources.claim: Audio/visual memory budgets need modality-aware perturbation allocation rather than generic token scoring.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Tiny modality-budget probe: construct two-channel memory where one modality is brittle to perturbation and ask whether budget allocation beats uniform retention.

sources.title: From Failed Trajectories to Reliable LLM Agents
sources.claim: Agent reliability depends on the harness/runtime, not only the base model; failed trajectories are objects for diagnosis and repair.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Execution-state verify probe: failure traces, false success, and branch revision boundaries are treated as harness state, not only memory retrieval artifacts.

sources.title: Triggered Poisoning of Multimodal Memories in Web Agents
sources.claim: Memory poisoning can be trigger-conditioned and multimodal, so future retrieval can activate delayed unsafe behavior.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Triggered memory poisoning toy: add dormant trigger variables to memory admissibility HPO and measure attack activation after benign retrieval.
sources.charter_role: side-wing: state/trust/safety, not core project focus

sources.title: Bridging the Agent-World Gap: Text World Models for LLM-based Agents
sources.claim: Textual state transition models can support planning, verification, adaptation, and evaluation for LLM agents operating in web/code/tool environments.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Text-world transition toy: compare reactive agents, memory retrieval, and learned symbolic transition predictors on tiny textual state machines.

sources.title: Agent System Operations: Categorization, Challenges, and Opportunities
sources.claim: Agent memory anomalies span short-term context and long-term memory, and agent systems need operations-level observability/governance.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Memory anomaly audit: classify probe failures as context omission, stale memory, poisoned memory, unsupported abstraction, or execution-state corruption.
sources.charter_role: side-wing: state/trust/safety, not core project focus

sources.title: A3: an Analytical Low-Rank Approximation Framework for Attention
sources.claim: Splits Transformer compression into QK, OV, and MLP functional components and derives component-level analytical low-rank reductions that cut model size, KV cache, and FLOPs without extra runtime GEMMs.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ component-rank allocator: compare uniform, raw-energy, functional-greedy, HPO-local, and oracle rank allocations under equal budgets and synthetic QK/OV/MLP fragility regimes.

sources.title: Gated Subspace Inference for Transformer Acceleration
sources.claim: Decomposes activation vectors into a low-rank subspace component plus residual and uses a per-token gate to skip residual corrections while preserving output distributions within tolerance.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ gated subspace toy: compare full linear, subspace-only, residual-norm gate, cheap predictive gate, two-stage gate, and oracle impact gate under rare residual-spike regimes.

sources.title: Make Each Token Count: Towards Improving Long-Context Performance with KV Cache Eviction
sources.claim: Argues full-cache attention can be suboptimal because irrelevant tokens dilute useful evidence; learned global retention can improve long-context performance, not only approximate full cache.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ attention-dilution eviction probe: compare full cache, recency, attention top-k, geometric proxy, learned retention, and oracle future utility under equal budgets.

sources.title: Dynamic Short Convolutions Improve Transformers
sources.claim: Introduces input-dependent short convolution filters as a Transformer primitive; reports stronger associative-recall behavior and scaling-law compute advantage when applied to Q/K/V or broadly after linear layers.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ dynamic-short-convolution wind tunnel: identity vs static convolution vs dynamic QKV filters vs every-linear dynamic filters under local-hint, aliasing, bursty-distractor, and no-locality regimes.

sources.title: Dynamic sparsity in tree-structured feed-forward layers at scale
sources.claim: Studies hard tree-structured sparse FFN layers as MLP replacements, activating fewer than 5% of FFN units per token while matching dense baselines in their setup and observing emergent auto-pruning.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ tree-sparse FFN toy: dense, flat top-k, hard tree, auto-pruned tree, balance-repaired tree, and oracle under skewed, shifting, rare-skill, and balanced regimes.

sources.title: A Curvature-Conditioned Query for Linear Attention
sources.claim: Frames linear attention as recurrent fast-weight memory and proposes shaping query readout with curvature information to repair selection behavior when bulk memory dilutes relevant keys.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ curvature-query fast-weight toy: additive memory, delta memory, curvature-conditioned query, Q-delta-style readout, and mixture policy on bulk-distractor and high-collision associative recall.

sources.title: Adaptive Memory Decay for Log-Linear Attention
sources.claim: Learns input-dependent decay over Fenwick/log-linear attention levels, preserving log-linear complexity while improving long-range memory tasks over fixed decay.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ adaptive Fenwick decay toy: sliding window, fixed low/high decay, softmax level decay, input-adaptive softplus decay, and oracle on old-needle/recent-burst/topic-shift regimes.

sources.title: CART: Context-Anchored Recurrent Transformer -- A Parameter-Efficient Architecture with Learned Stability
sources.claim: Reports a context-anchored recurrent Transformer with frozen K/V anchor and learned stability gate, but also a negative result: short-screen loop-count rankings can reverse at full training and dense baselines remain hard to beat.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ CART screen-reversal toy: stage-1 screen picks vs width-aware loop prior vs robust two-stage screening vs full oracle, measuring regret from cheap screening.

sources.title: Focus and Dilution: The Multi-stage Learning Process of Attention
sources.claim: Identifies focus-dilution cycles in attention learning, with rank-one condensation, frequency-driven focus, mass redistribution, and repeated opening of new embedding directions.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future tiny training monitor: plot attention focus/dilution phases during Markov or modular sequence training and use phase changes as a probe-selection signal.

sources.title: Language Models Need Sleep: Learning to Self-Modify and Consolidate Memories
sources.claim: Proposes a sleep/dreaming paradigm for consolidating fragile short-term knowledge into long-term parameters and generating curriculum data for self-improvement.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future tiny offline-consolidation toy: alternate online scratch-memory solving with offline replay/distillation and measure whether replay beats direct continued training.

sources.title: Gated Bidirectional Linear Attention for Generative Retrieval
sources.claim: Introduces a gated bidirectional linear attention mechanism for long-context generative retrieval with linear-time training/inference while maintaining retrieval quality.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future C++/Python retrieval probe: compare bidirectional linear kernels against exact bidirectional attention on generative retrieval support recovery and candidate recall.

sources.title: STAR: Rethinking MoE Routing as Structure-Aware Subspace Learning
sources.claim: Treats MoE routing as subspace learning and augments standard routing with an evolving principal subspace, with optional test-time subspace updates under distribution shift.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native subspace-router wind tunnel: compare shallow, balanced, static-subspace, online-subspace, rare-explorer, and oracle routers under cluster, shift, rare-domain, and load traps.

sources.title: MoE Routing Testbed: Studying Expert Specialization and Routing Behavior at Small Scale
sources.claim: Small-scale MoE testbed with distinguishable domains and reference routing can expose expert specialization and balancing behavior that ordinary small-scale performance metrics hide.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Use domain-labeled synthetic routing regimes and reference/oracle routers to separate specialization, load balance, rare-expert coverage, and router instability.

sources.title: How Much Dense Attention is Necessary? Oracle-Guided Sparse Prefill for Full/GQA Layers in Hybrid Long-Context Models
sources.claim: Uses dense-attention oracle targets to separate sparse budget reducibility, learned-indexer gap, and runtime realization gap for sparse prefill.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native sparse-prefill gap probe: top-k oracle, block-shared oracle, learned indexer, local repair, dense baseline, and random support under support-fraction budgets.

sources.title: Sigma-Branch: Hierarchical Single-Path Network Reconstruction for Dynamic Inference with Reduced Active Parameters
sources.claim: Restructures a pretrained dense network into a hierarchical binary tree with shared trunk, routers, and specialized leaves, executing a single path at inference.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future C++ tree-routing phase diagram: compare flat sparse FFN, single-path tree, soft router, and dense under rare-path and shifting-cluster regimes.

sources.title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning with Learnable Rank
sources.claim: Questions fixed-rank LoRA and reports layer/module-specific rank preferences when rank becomes learnable.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future rank-allocation toy: learn or search layer/component ranks under a strict parameter budget and compare against uniform LoRA ranks.

sources.title: TwinQuant: Learnable Subspace Decomposition for 4-Bit LLM Quantization
sources.claim: Uses learnable decomposed subspace reparameterization to make low-rank factors, residuals, and activations friendlier to 4-bit quantization.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future quantization toy: compare fixed low-rank/residual splits to reparameterized splits under activation outliers and equal bit budgets.

sources.title: Beyond FLOPs: Benchmarking Real Inference Acceleration of LLM Pruning under a GEMM-Centric Taxonomy
sources.claim: Shows pruning/sparsity speedups depend on GEMM alignment, kernel overhead, sequence length, and module balance, not just FLOP reduction.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native real-speed guard: score sparse/pruned methods with wall-time proxy, GEMM alignment, dynamic overhead, quality loss, and FLOP-vs-speedup gap.

sources.title: Systematic Empirical Validation and Diagnosis of Matrix and Tensor Decompositions for LLM Compression
sources.claim: Reports that tensor decompositions fail to outperform matrix counterparts at matched compression under realistic deployment constraints and diagnoses shared-subspace mismatch.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native tensor-vs-matrix sanity probe: shared-subspace tensor methods versus componentwise matrix SVD and repair under head/expert heterogeneity and outlier regimes.

sources.title: A Unifying View of Attention Sinks: Two Algorithms, Two Solutions
sources.claim: Distinguishes NOP/trash-can sinks from broadcast sinks and argues identical vertical attention stripes can require different interventions such as gating or registers.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native sink-mechanism diagnostic: decide whether gating, register tokens, both, or neither help depending on NOP-vs-broadcast mechanism.

sources.title: STAR-KV: Low-Rank KV Cache Compression via Soft Thresholding for Adaptive Rank Control
sources.claim: Uses differentiable soft-threshold rank selection, hybrid K/V decomposition, and low-rank-aware mixed precision for KV-cache compression.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future STAR-KV toy: learn soft thresholds per head/block in native rank-frontier probes rather than using hand-coded rank schedules.

sources.title: Mixture of Sparse Attention: Content-Based Learnable Sparse Attention via Expert-Choice Routing
sources.claim: Uses expert-choice routing to select sparse tokens per attention head, aiming for content-based learned sparse attention and more heads under equal compute.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future MoSA-inspired probe: expert-choice token selection versus token-choice top-k under equal compute, head specialization, and candidate recall.

sources.title: DOT-MoE: Differentiable Optimal Transport for MoEfication
sources.claim: Formulates dense-to-MoE FFN decomposition as differentiable optimal transport with balanced Sinkhorn assignments and joint token routing; reports retaining about 90% dense performance with 50% active-parameter reduction.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native DOT-MoE transport toy: compare random split, clustering, balanced greedy, Sinkhorn-like balanced assignment, and joint routing under rare-neuron, capacity, anisotropy, and route-shift traps.

sources.title: HASTE: Hardware-Aware Dynamic Sparse Training for Large Output Spaces
sources.claim: Uses group-shared fixed fan-in sparsity and dense-head/sparse-tail decomposition to turn output-layer sparsity into practical kernel speedups; reports large forward/backward speedups in XMC settings.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native group-shared sparse-tail toy: test whether semantic grouping and feature reuse are enough to beat dense/irregular sparse baselines under kernel-overhead and long-tail regimes.

sources.title: The Sparse Frontier: Sparse Attention Trade-offs in Transformer LLMs
sources.claim: Large empirical sparse-attention comparison finds sparse attention is phase/task dependent, with different strategies needed for prefill/decode and no universal sparse winner.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native isoFLOPS frontier toy: compare small dense, larger sparse, hybrid, and oracle sparse policies across task regimes and prefill/decode phases.

sources.title: Training Non-Differentiable Networks via Optimal Transport
sources.claim: PolyStep updates parameters using forward-pass evaluations at structured polytope vertices and reports strong results on hard MoE routing, argmax attention, int8 quantization, and other non-differentiable components.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native PolyHard routing toy: ask when forward-only geometric updates beat surrogate/ES/random search for hard routing surfaces.

sources.title: Task Structure Reverses Layerwise State Encoding in Sequence Models
sources.claim: Shows layerwise state localization can reverse across tasks and architectures, so mechanistic signatures are task+architecture properties rather than architectural constants.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future tiny-trained state-probe: compare parity, Dyck, copying, and associative recall to see whether readable state profiles reverse in our small models.

sources.title: Generic Triple-Latent Compression with Gated Associative Retrieval
sources.claim: Studies triple-latent sequence compression with gated associative retrieval; byte-level LM improves over a small Transformer baseline in some settings, but associative recall remains a problem.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future triple-latent probe: separate byte-level compression gain from exact recall failure, using the same synthetic recall tasks as attention/linear-memory probes.

sources.title: Accelerating Sparse Transformer Inference on GPU
sources.claim: STOF emphasizes flexible sparse MHA kernels and adaptive operator fusion, reporting sparse-MHA and end-to-end speedups over prior GPU baselines.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Use as systems pressure for the real-speed guard: sparse-mask wins need kernel/representation overhead fields, not only FLOP counts.

sources.title: Sparsity Moves Computation: How FFN Architecture Reshapes Attention in Small Transformers
sources.claim: In one-layer small transformers, FFN design choices such as MoE, GLU, and sparse routing can redistribute task computation into attention; frozen random routing can nearly match learned routing in some settings.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native symbolic and later tiny-trained probes: hold task and parameter/FLOP budget fixed while changing FFN sparsity and measure attention-shift debt, ablation sensitivity, and route-learning gap.

sources.title: STAR-KV: Low-Rank KV Cache Compression via Soft Thresholding for Adaptive Rank Control
sources.claim: Adaptive thresholding over singular values, K/V-sensitive hybrid decomposition, and low-rank-aware mixed precision improve KV-cache compression/rank allocation versus static rank choices.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ low-rank rank-allocation wind tunnel: compare uniform ranks, sensitivity heuristics, soft thresholds, K/V-asymmetric decompositions, and mixed precision under synthetic spectral regimes.

sources.title: Sparsely gated tiny linear experts
sources.claim: Replacing FFN layers with very sparse gates over many tiny linear neurons can improve compute efficiency and interpretability under isoflop comparisons.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ isoFLOP tiny-expert simulator: compare dense FFN, MoE, random tiny experts, sgatlin, and nonlinear repair on reusable-linear, dense-semantic, and rare-nonlinear regimes.

sources.title: Scaling Linear Attention with Sparse State Expansion
sources.claim: Row-sparse linear-attention updates and expanded state partitions can reduce interference in fixed-state long-context models and improve retrieval/reasoning behavior.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ sparse-state probe: compare single-state linear attention, row-sparse updates, partitioned state expansion, and hybrid attention under recall/collision/multihop regimes.

sources.title: AutoCompress: Critical Layer Isolation for Efficient Transformer Compression
sources.claim: Small transformers may have layers with disproportionate task-critical information; protecting critical layers can beat uniform bottleneck compression.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ layer-compression proxy: compare uniform bottlenecks, layer-0 protection, middle/late protection, and HPO-selected protected layers under shifted critical-layer regimes.

sources.title: Value-and-Structure Alignment for Routing-Consistent Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts Models
sources.claim: MoE quantization should preserve expert-selection/routing structure, not only value reconstruction error.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future MoE quantization toy: separate output-MSE from top-k expert consistency under quantized routers and experts.

sources.title: Redesign Mixture-of-Experts Routers with Manifold Power Iteration
sources.claim: Router rows can be aligned to expert principal singular directions through a power-then-retract update, improving router/expert affinity.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native MPI router toy: compare random/centroid/load-balanced routers against one-step and two-step power-retract policies under rare-domain and load-balance traps.

sources.title: nD-RoPE: A Generalized RoPE for n-Dimensional Position Embedding
sources.claim: High-dimensional RoPE should use coupled position/frequency wave vectors for isotropic, direction-balanced behavior rather than independent per-axis rotations.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native nD-RoPE isotropy probe: compare axis-separable, mixed, random, and simplex wave-vector designs under rotated-grid and extrapolation regimes.

sources.title: VIA-SD: Verification via Intra-Model Routing for Speculative Decoding
sources.claim: Speculative decoding can add a routed slim verifier tier between direct acceptance and full verification to reduce expensive verifier calls.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native tiered verifier toy: compare binary accept/full verify with three-tier slim-verifier policies over draft-quality/confidence regimes.

sources.title: Multi-Rate Mixture of Experts for Accelerating Liquid Neural Network Training
sources.claim: Experts operating at distinct time scales can separate fast and slow dynamics in heterogeneous sequence data.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future C++/Python time-constant toy: route synthetic fast/slow processes to experts and score interference, latency, and specialization.

sources.title: Augmenting Molecular Language Models with Local n-gram Memory
sources.claim: A local n-gram memory can augment sequence language models in structured string domains.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future toy: compare learned short-context model with external local n-gram memory on synthetic grammar strings and rare motif completion.

sources.title: On Subquadratic Architectures: From Applications to Principles
sources.claim: Recent subquadratic architectures should be evaluated by principle/task regime rather than marketed speed claims.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Use as taxonomy pressure: every subquadratic toy must state what task family it can and cannot preserve at equal budget.

sources.title: Attention by Synchronization in Coupled Oscillator Networks
sources.claim: Fixed-query oscillator dynamics can approximate an attention-like operation without exponentiation/global softmax reduction, aimed at physical substrates.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future oscillator-attention toy: compare softmax, cosine normalization, and iterative synchronization under cost/iteration budgets.

sources.title: Fundamental Limitations on Subquadratic Alternatives to Transformers
sources.claim: Some tasks that transformers can express may require quadratic computation under fine-grained complexity assumptions, limiting universal subquadratic claims.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Negative guard cell: include pairwise/document-similarity-like tasks in tiny batteries so subquadratic wins do not overgeneralize.

sources.title: Chiaroscuro Attention: Spending Compute in the Dark Operator Routing via Spectral Entropy Across Tasks and Scales
sources.claim: Spectral-entropy routing over operators found a collapsed DCT+Attention configuration that improved WikiText-103 perplexity while reducing attention FLOPs, but the paper also reports boundary conditions where small/synthetic tasks favor uniform attention.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native spectral-operator wind tunnel: DCT-only, RBF-only, full attention, DCT+attention collapse, entropy router, and oracle operator mix under equal budget and alias traps.

sources.title: ProbMoE: Differentiable Probabilistic Routing for Mixture-of-Experts
sources.claim: ProbMoE treats MoE routing as differentiable probabilistic subset selection, using valid k-subsets and gradient estimates over expert-selection marginals while preserving sparse execution.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native subset-exploration toy: deterministic top-k vs probabilistic subset exploration under rare-expert, complementarity, noisy-router, and load-pressure regimes.

sources.title: Spike-Aware C++ INT8 Inference for Sparse Spiking Language Models on Commodity CPUs
sources.claim: Treating spike/activation sparsity as an execution primitive in a C++ INT8 runtime can change CPU throughput/memory behavior; the paper flags model quality and energy measurement as open problems.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native CPU wall-proxy probe: dense INT8, naive sparse index, block sparse, spike-aware CSR, and hybrid threshold fallback under bursty/tiny-batch/cache-pressure regimes.

sources.title: Multi-Head Attention as a Source of Catastrophic Forgetting in MoE Transformers
sources.claim: The paper attributes some MoE continual-learning failures to a pre-routing bottleneck where concatenated attention heads mix multiple factors before routing, motivating head-wise routing.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native head-wise router collision toy: concat routing vs head-wise/factorized routing under co-occurring factors, task drift, load pressure, and noisy head features.

sources.title: Union of Experts: Adapting Hierarchical Routing to Equivalently Decomposed Transformer
sources.claim: UoE decomposes transformer computation into equivalent expert groups and applies hierarchical routing across patch/input and expert decisions, including attention blocks.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future hierarchical-routing toy: compare flat MoE, head-wise MoE, and two-stage token/operator routing under equal wall-proxy budgets.

sources.title: EPIC: Efficient and Parallel Inference under CFG Constraints for Diffusion Language Models
sources.claim: EPIC accelerates CFG-constrained diffusion LM decoding with lexing memoization, DFA-free/Earley-style validation, and compatible subset selection for parallel token commits.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future C++ decoding-control toy: memoized validation and parallel commit frontier for JSON/C++-like grammars under correctness-preserving constraints.

sources.title: Incremental Learning of Sparse Attention Patterns in Transformers
sources.claim: A high-order Markov task shows transformers can learn sparse attention patterns incrementally, acquiring different lag dependencies in stages.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Tiny trained Markov-lag task: detect staged acquisition and compare sparse/local/full heads under teacher-known dependency structure.

sources.title: Efficient Sparse Attention for Long-Range Transformers / SparseK Attention
sources.claim: SparseK prioritizes subsets of key-value pairs to reduce long-range attention cost while trying to maintain performance.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Use as a baseline in sparse-frontier probes; require equal-cost comparison against dense, hybrid, and oracle support.

sources.title: Meta-Attention: Bayesian Per-Token Routing for Efficient Transformer Inference
sources.claim: Routes each token among full softmax, linear/kernel, and sliding-window attention through a Bayesian meta-controller with compute-aware Dirichlet prior and uncertainty-controlled hard routing.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Build a tiny mechanism-router probe with full/local/linear/spectral experts, cost prior, uncertainty, and routing-collapse traps.

sources.title: Don’t Pay Attention / Avey ranker-contextualization architecture
sources.claim: Avey-style architecture uses a ranker for contextualization and reports long needle retrieval/extrapolation advantages despite shorter training context.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Simulate split ranking under candidate-set recall, semantic alias, neighbor expansion, and equal-cost contextualization.

sources.title: Improving MoE Compute Efficiency by Composing Weight and Data Sparsity
sources.claim: Adds null experts to causal token-choice MoE so some routing slots consume zero compute, composing weight sparsity with data sparsity without expert-choice causality mismatch.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Probe null-expert policies against false-skip, rare-critical token loss, load balance, and active-compute budget.

sources.title: Efficient Quantization of Mixture-of-Experts with Theoretical Generalization Guarantees
sources.claim: Expert-wise mixed precision should protect experts whose router norms changed less or whose intra-neuron variance is high, because those experts can encode infrequent but critical features.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future route-consistent quantization probe: compare reconstruction-only, router-norm, variance, and rare-expert precision policies.

sources.title: Mixture of Experts for Low-Resource LLMs
sources.claim: Underrepresented languages can show deep-layer routing collapse; continual pretraining can increase routing entropy and shared expert use more than SFT alone.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Use as a rare-domain/load-collapse regime for MoE router wind tunnels and routing-signature telemetry.

sources.title: Lightweight Transformer Architectures for Edge Devices in Resource-Constrained Environments
sources.claim: Survey-level synthesis: sparse attention, mixed precision, and hardware-aware NAS are among the most effective edge transformer optimization strategies.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Keep as a reminder that CloudtainerML phase probes need wall/kernel/device proxies, not just algorithmic FLOP counts.

sources.title: Transformers are Better than State Space Models at Copying
sources.claim: Fixed-size latent-state models can be fundamentally limited on copying/retrieval tasks where transformers use context-dependent access.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Use as a copying/needle baseline whenever ranker, SSM, linear attention, or Fenwick-style memory looks too good.

sources.title: Phase Transitions in Attention: A Bayesian Theory of Copy Head Emergence
sources.claim: Derives a Bayesian theory of copy-head emergence; softmax attention shows an abrupt first-order transition while linear attention shows a second-order transition followed by smooth crossover.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Tiny C++/Python copy-task phase probe: sweep sequence length, vocab size, and sample count; compare softmax, linear, annealed, and hybrid attention for loss, precursor signal, and monitorability.

sources.title: LoLA: Low-Rank Linear Attention With Sparse Caching
sources.claim: Augments linear attention with recent softmax chunks and a sparse cache selected by self-recall error to improve associative recall under constant-ish memory.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ expert-choice/sparse-cache frontier: compare local windows, content sparse attention, LoLA-like sparse cache, and hybrid sparse-cache routing on recurrent versus rare-needle regimes.

sources.title: Confidence-Adaptive SwiGLU for Mixture-of-Experts
sources.claim: Adapts SwiGLU behavior in MoE settings based on confidence, aiming for better compute/performance tradeoffs under router uncertainty.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native confidence-adaptive activation probe: compare dense SwiGLU, standard top-k MoE, confidence-adaptive SwiGLU, rare-expert guards, and dense fallback under ambiguous/rare/overconfident regimes.

sources.title: DAG-MoE: From Simple Mixture to Structural Aggregation in Mixture-of-Experts
sources.claim: Reframes MoE aggregation as a structured DAG rather than a flat weighted mixture, suggesting intermediate expert-composition topologies.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future tiny MoE routing graph probe: compare flat top-k, tree/DAG aggregation, and route-consistency costs under rare-composition tasks.

sources.title: Attention and Compression is all you need for Controllably Efficient Language Modeling
sources.claim: Frames efficient language modeling as a controllable tradeoff between attention and compression, reinforcing equal-budget frontier discipline.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Use as a taxonomy/checklist source for sparse/low-rank/spectral/frontier probes; every win should be plotted against budget and exact-recall loss.

sources.title: Gated Bidirectional Linear Attention for Generative Retrieval
sources.claim: Extends kernelized linear attention with local causal mixing, sequence-level key gating/forgetting, and gated RMSNorm for long-history generative retrieval.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Rev0030 C++ probe compares bidirectional self-attention, plain linear attention, local-conv repair, key gating, GBLA-style all-in, and hybrid SA/GBLA.

sources.title: On Subquadratic Architectures: From Applications to Principles
sources.claim: Compares xLSTM, Mamba-2, and Gated DeltaNet across complex dependencies and argues xLSTM gains come from robust state tracking and memory correction via gating.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ state-correction wind tunnel comparing additive, decay, residual-gated, xLSTM-like gated correction, and oracle correction policies.

sources.title: Attention by Synchronization in Coupled Oscillator Networks
sources.claim: Replaces softmax arithmetic with Kuramoto-style synchronization dynamics for energy-constrained physical substrates; reports competitive small-dimension results and better behavior as oscillator dimension grows.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ no-exp/cosine attention proxy: compare softmax, top-k softmax, relu normalization, and cosine/oscillator-style readouts under sharp, broad, alias, negative-score, and tail-needle regimes.

sources.title: Harness In-Context Operator Learning with Chain of Operators
sources.claim: Constructs chains of explicit elementary transformations plus a frozen in-context operator network to improve OOD operator tasks without parameter updates.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future toy: compare direct learned operator, explicit pre/post operator harnesses, and learned router over elementary transformations on symbolic function families.

sources.title: Efficient Multinomial Logistic Bandit via Frequent Directions
sources.claim: Uses Frequent Directions-style sketching to make multinomial logistic bandits more efficient, suggesting streaming subspace sketches as a cheap memory/compression primitive.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future C++ sketch frontier: compare FD, reservoir, random projection, and exact covariance for streaming low-rank memory under drift and rare-direction regimes.

sources.title: Phase Transitions in Attention: A Bayesian Theory of Copy Head Emergence
sources.claim: Derives a copy-head emergence phase transition and contrasts first-order softmax behavior with smoother linear-attention crossover.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Rev0032 trained tiny pointer-copy model comparing softmax, sparsemax, relu-normalized, and cosine readouts with target-mass and abruptness guards.

sources.title: Routing Absorption in Sparse Attention: Why Random Gates Are Hard to Beat
sources.claim: End-to-end sparse attention gates can be absorbed by Q/K/V co-adaptation, making learned gates only slightly better than frozen random gates in the reported setup.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native routing_absorption_gate wind tunnel contrasts random, learned, posthoc, dense-escape, and oracle sparse gates under co-adaptation, deployment-shift, and rare-route regimes.

sources.title: Directional Routing in Transformers
sources.claim: Lightweight learned suppression directions controlled by a shared router can become a dominant coordination pathway for attention heads in the reported model.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native directional_suppression_router probe scores shared suppression directions against independent heads, fixed pruners, random suppression, and oracle coordination.

sources.title: Self-Routing: Parameter-Free Expert Routing from Hidden States
sources.claim: A designated hidden-state subspace can serve as MoE expert logits, removing dedicated router parameters while staying competitive with learned routers in the reported settings.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native self_routing_entropy probe tests hidden-subspace alignment, entropy/balance, rare experts, and drift against learned, random, hash, and dense baselines.

sources.title: Contribution Weights: A Geometrical Analysis of Self-Attention Transformers
sources.claim: Attention weights alone neglect value-vector magnitude and directional alignment; projection-style contribution weights estimate token influence more geometrically.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native contribution_weight_geometry probe asks when attention mass, value norm, direction alignment, or contribution-style scoring better predicts retention/output error.

sources.title: Task-Conditioned Routing Signatures in Sparse Mixture-of-Experts Transformers
sources.claim: MoE expert-activation signatures can cluster by task category and expose task-conditioned structure in routing telemetry.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future routing-family telemetry: route signatures become a cheap observable for whether tiny routers learn task structure or only load balance.

sources.title: Mixture-of-Experts Transformer for Automatic Modulation Recognition
sources.claim: Adaptive multi-scale MoE Transformer routing can fuse temporal expert views for I/Q signal classification in the reported AMR benchmarks.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future tiny signal toy: route between resampled temporal expert views and test whether multiscale experts beat fixed fusion under drift/noise.

sources.title: Query Lens: Interpreting Sparse Key-Value Features with Indirect Effects
sources.claim: Sparse key/value features should be characterized by both what activates them and what outputs they promote, including indirect effects.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future diagnostic guard for cache/value probes: key-side activation and value-side contribution should be separated.

sources.title: Locality Does Not Imply Reachability: Boundary Repair in Block-Sparse Causal Attention
sources.claim: Fixed block-causal masks can make adjacent cross-boundary tokens unreachable at any depth; Bridge/PBB/SE-Bridge style repairs restore specific missing causal edges with phase-dependent coverage.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ graph wind tunnel: exact reachability, boundary phase, source/write-back coverage, and exact-copy veto for block, sliding-window, and boundary-repair masks.

sources.title: Sessa: Selective State Space Attention
sources.claim: Places attention inside a recurrent feedback path and argues for slower power-law memory tails plus flexible selective retrieval compared with Transformer and Mamba-style matched baselines.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future C++ state-tail wind tunnel: compare one-shot attention, recurrent state, and attention-in-feedback under old-needle, diffuse-attention, and selective-retrieval regimes.

sources.title: π-Attention: Periodic Sparse Transformers for Efficient Long-Context Modeling
sources.claim: Combines ring-local attention, deterministic periodic skip attention, and adaptive fusion for linear-complexity long-context modeling with predictable coverage, but fixed periods can be off-phase.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Fold periodic skip connections into the sparse attention program schema and test boundary/off-phase reachability against sliding, bridge, and dense baselines.

sources.title: Preconditioned Attention: Enhancing Efficiency in Transformers
sources.claim: Adds a conditioning matrix to attention heads to reduce ill-conditioned attention matrices and improve optimization across several Transformer settings.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ conditioning wind tunnel: compare raw dot attention, whitening, ridge and clipped preconditioning under anisotropic keys, rare-axis signal, and alias regimes.

sources.title: Sparse Growing Transformer: Training-Time Sparse Depth Allocation via Progressive Attention Looping
sources.claim: Allocates extra recurrent attention depth progressively from deeper to shallower layers and selectively loops high-entropy heads, treating depth as training-time structural sparsity.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Future trained-tiny screen: compare fixed loop depth, entropy-triggered head looping, and deep-to-shallow schedules on copy/head emergence or algorithmic tasks.

sources.title: Resonant Context Anchoring: Decoupling Attention Routing and Signal Gain at Inference Time
sources.claim: Attention routing can point to the right evidence while value-signal magnitude is too weak to overcome high-norm parametric/internal noise; the proposed RCA-style idea modulates value gain without changing routing distribution.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native C++ wind tunnel separates route error from gain error and tests route-only, gain-only, importance-aware and route+gain policies under weak-value/deep-attenuation/distractor regimes.

sources.title: When Does Routing Become Interpretable? Causal Probes on Block Attention Residuals
sources.claim: Exposing cross-layer routing weights is not sufficient for interpretation: a posthoc recency schedule can produce readable routing tensors that are content-independent and uninformative under causal probes.
sources.cloudtainer_test: C++ depth-route interpretability probe compares posthoc recency schedules, learned content routes, patch probes and causal ablations under content-switch/deep-feature/confounded regimes.

sources.title: Attention at the Theoretical Minimum: A Mathematics of Arrays Framework for Memory-Optimal Transformer Kernels
sources.claim: Reformulates scaled dot-product attention through a Mathematics-of-Arrays denotational normal form that removes intermediate arrays and targets theoretical-minimum memory traffic; it stresses memory traffic over FLOPs.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Use as an audit lens: any sparse/operator phase screen should report memory traffic, intermediate materialization and kernel/layout penalties, not just nominal arithmetic density.

sources.title: Sparse Attention Post-Training for Mechanistic Interpretability
sources.claim: Applies sparsity regularization under a constrained-loss objective after pretraining, reporting very sparse attention connectivity while retaining model loss and simplifying circuits.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Use as pressure for posthoc sparse-gate tests: compare end-to-end learned gates, posthoc gates, and sparse-regularized fine-tuning on tiny copy/reachability tasks.

sources.title: Variational Routing: A Scalable Bayesian Framework for Calibrated Mixture-of-Experts Transformers
sources.claim: Confines Bayesian uncertainty modeling to the MoE router, reporting improved routing stability, calibration, and OOD detection with low FLOP overhead.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Use as a routing uncertainty baseline: test deterministic gates against temperature/uncertainty-aware sparse routers under ambiguous route and rare-domain traps.

sources.title: MiniMax Sparse Attention
sources.claim: Uses a lightweight Index Branch to score/select KV blocks per GQA group, always retains the local block, and co-designs kernels so block sparsity translates into wall-clock speed at very long context.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Fold group-shared block selection into the sparse program/page-cost schema; test local-block anchoring, block top-k, exact-copy vetoes, and selector overhead against bridge/window masks.

sources.title: Gated Sparse Attention: Combining Computational Efficiency with Training Stability for Long-Context Language Models
sources.claim: Combines sigmoid sparse selection scores, an adaptive sparsity controller, and value/output gating; reports long-context speed/quality/stability gains and reduced attention-sink behavior.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Use as a future hard-gate baseline: compare bounded sigmoid scores, adaptive k, value/output gates, and top-k compilation under boundary exactness and deployment-gap guards.

sources.title: SpargeAttention: Accurate and Training-free Sparse Attention Accelerating Any Model Inference
sources.claim: Uses a two-stage online filter to predict the attention map and then apply a softmax-aware filter to skip attention matmuls across diverse model families.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Compare score-filter compilers against post-trained gates and block top-k under exact-copy, false-spike, threshold-calibration, and realized-cost fields.

sources.title: SpargeAttention2: Trainable Sparse Attention via Hybrid Top-k+Top-p Masking and Distillation Fine-Tuning
sources.claim: Hybrid Top-k plus Top-p masking and distillation fine-tuning can avoid high-sparsity failures where pure Top-k or Top-p drops important computation; reported 95% sparse attention and large runtime speedup in video diffusion settings.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Add hybrid mask compiler rows to gate-compiler frontier: compare threshold, top-k, top-p, hybrid top-k/top-p, and validation-selected compiler under uniform-row, skew-row, false-spike, and shrunken-ranking regimes.

sources.title: Guess-Verify-Refine: Data-Aware Top-K for Sparse-Attention Decoding on Blackwell via Temporal Correlation
sources.claim: Uses previous-step Top-K as a temporal prediction signal, then verifies/refines an exact candidate set to reduce full-row passes while preserving exact Top-K outputs in sparse-attention decoding.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Native temporal top-k wind tunnel: simulate stable, drifting, bursty, phase-shifted, and flat score streams; compare exact baseline, GVR fallback, aggressive approximate GVR, thresholding, and previous-top-k reuse on exactness and selector cost.

sources.title: You Only Index Once: Cross-Layer Sparse Attention with Shared Routing
sources.claim: Extends KV sharing to routing-index sharing: a single top-k routing index is computed once and reused across layers, reducing routing overhead while trying to preserve token-sparse selectivity.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Test shared block/token index reuse against group-specific and layer-divergent supports; score route drift, selector amortization, exact-copy misses, and wall-proxy cost.

sources.title: Top-Theta Attention: Sparsifying Transformers by Compensated Thresholding
sources.claim: Calibrated per-model thresholds can replace top-k attention search in some content-based sparsity settings, with denominator and mean-value compensation to preserve output quality.
sources.cloudtainer_test: Use as threshold compiler baseline: compare calibrated thresholds with top-k, hybrid top-k/top-p, and validation top-k under shrunken scores, false spikes, and exact-copy vetoes.

sources.note: Offline/firewalled Transformers use requires downloaded and cached files ahead of time; HF_HUB_OFFLINE and local_files_only are the loader controls after that material exists.
huggingface_hub downloads and caches individual files or entire repositories independently of downstream model loading.
snapshot_download accepts revision, local_dir/cache_dir, local_files_only, allow_patterns, dry_run, and can report incomplete snapshot errors.
HF_HOME and HF_HUB_CACHE define cache locations and the hub reads relevant environment variables at import time.
safetensors is a safe, fast tensor storage format and remains a better default for the model-source contract than pickle weights.
CUDA events are intended for monitoring device progress and accurate device timing; named-hardware timing remains a later gate, not a snapshot-prep blocker.
